name: Controlling
tagline: Safeguarding the numbers behind every entity: journals, cash, transfer pricing and statutory compliance.
pickerIntro: Fourteen Controlling processes spanning revenue accruals, cash and working capital, month-end close, transfer pricing and statutory audit.

context.label: Solutions
context.text: A Global MJV Playbook and MJV dashboard are being deployed for month-end journals, centralised NTI governance was set up in July 2025, an RPT dashboard is being piloted for FS disclosure and local TP review, and an end-to-end statutory audit support model is planned.

context.label: Automation
context.text: Global automation of the FSC011 and FSC009c review templates removes manual working-file preparation, bad debt journal preparation is being automated for global scale-up, and the Power BI BSI pack underpins the balance sheet integrity review.

context.label: AI
context.text: All AI items are proposals: an AI journal agent, a variance analysis agent, an AI-enabled cash flow control tower, AI-driven DSO prediction, AI support across the audit cycle, and AI-enabled control monitoring with automated evidence collection. None is documented as deployed.

context.label: Cross-Functional Collaboration
context.text: Controlling works with CBP, FBP and CFOs on accruals and forecasts, Market Access on pricing and rebates, Treasury on cash flow, Group Tax, GTTP and CFC on intercompany and transfer pricing, GBS and Embedded Finance on close and spend, and external auditors on statutory audits.

processes.title: Selling price maintenance
processes.purpose:
Selling price maintenance keeps AZ SAP selling prices aligned with the prices agreed by the local Market Access team. When Market Access issues a price change memo, GFS Controllers update the selling prices in SAP for the wholesaler and direct-plus-consignment business models, while the Market Access team itself updates prices for pure consignment model markets.

The output is a maintained selling price in SAP. Keeping the price current matters because any gap between the AZ SAP price and the distributor's system creates a mismatch risk at invoicing.

processes.title: Gross-to-Net accruals
processes.purpose:
GFS Controlling reviews customer contractual obligations and calculates Gross-to-Net (GTN) accruals so that revenue is recognised at its expected net realisable value. The accruals cover incentive rebates, promotional discounts, patient affordability programmes (PAP), hospital paybacks, government clawbacks and product return provisions.

Controlling validates the assumptions, reviews the calculations with CBP, FBP and the CFO where required, determines the appropriate accounting treatment and posts the accrual journals in BlackLine and SAP. The process also covers the review of automated sales module postings and the reclassification of entries to comply with Sales Accounting GSOP requirements. The output is the GTN accrual manual journal.

processes.title: Bad debt provision
processes.purpose:
GFS Controlling reviews overdue trade receivables and disputed customer balances every month to assess expected credit losses (ECL). The bad debt provision is calculated under the AstraZeneca Bad Debt Provision Policy, applying a provision matrix based on ageing buckets and incorporating entity-specific risk factors and forward-looking information where appropriate.

The proposed provision is reviewed with the Finance Controller or CFO and posted during month-end close as the bad debt provision manual journal.

processes.title: Spend-to-payment market support
processes.purpose:
GFS Controlling supports Embedded Finance (EF) in resolving ad hoc spend-to-payment issues raised by market and local users, working from vendor invoices, accrual submissions and open PO reports. Typical topics are stuck invoice accruals and Coupa GR accrual increases, urgent payments, T&E cost capture in Concur, system access requests, open PO reporting, Other G&A budgeting support and CAPEX budget control.

Several activities are market-specific: in ANZ the team prepares a monthly Coupa PO status ahead of MEC and raises a non-PO invoice on behalf of the market; in the Philippines it supports the Other G&A budget cycle and the OBIEE Capex report; in Taiwan it sends weekly open PO reports to EF, supports Finance cost centre forecasting each budget cycle and maintains the CAPEX budget in SAP. Across all markets, Controllers monitor the timely creation and closure of audit and tax fee POs.

processes.title: Month-end manual journals
processes.purpose:
GFS Controlling prepares the judgmental manual journals required during month-end close, using data from SAP and Coupa and inputs from EF, local users and the GFS process towers. The journals fall into two types: globally SOP-approved journals such as stock provisions, bonus accruals and unutilised leave accruals, and preventable journals such as corrections and reclassifications, manual accruals, Coupa accruals, COBOU and indirect tax entries.

The output is the set of manual journals for the close. The volume of preventable journals is the focus of the TPI 2026 month-end close transformation, which aims to standardise journal governance and shift the close to a prevention-driven, right-first-time model.

processes.title: Working capital: cash flow forecast
processes.purpose:
GFS Controlling prepares and reviews a monthly six-month rolling cash flow forecast to support liquidity management, funding decisions and working capital optimisation across Asia Area markets. The forecast consolidates cash inflows and outflows: AR collections, AP payments, payroll, taxes, customs and duties, intercompany netting, loan movements and dividend payments. One of the key cash outflow elements is the purchase plan forecast obtained each month from the Asia Area Demand Planners.

The process gives visibility of the key cash drivers, forecast accuracy, liquidity exposures and funding requirements, enabling proactive management of working capital and early identification of cash risks. A cash flow dashboard shows forecast versus actual performance, trend analysis, accuracy tracking and cash position monitoring across the Asia Area markets.

processes.title: Statutory audit support
processes.purpose:
GFS Controlling supports the statutory audit end to end, from planning with the auditors, EF, Tax and GFS teams through walkthroughs, evidence (PBC) preparation, fieldwork and query management, financial statement review, audit adjustments, statutory filing and the post-audit review.

Each step has its own inputs and deliverables, from the agreed audit plan and completed walkthroughs to the audit evidence package, the final audited financial statements, posted P13 adjustments, filed statutory accounts and a retained audit repository with lessons learned. The TPI 2026 ambition is an end-to-end audit support model with centralised planning, repositories and testing.
